text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news. Beauty Anshinzawa, who had 
been reported missing, has safely returned 
home. According to the press conference, 
this year's Beauty Dream Cup will—

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry to keep you waiting☆ My little pony 
with quite the particular tastes♪ 
Now feast your eyes, this is the new 
design!

text_block_list.name: Client
text_block_list.text:
There are so many...?! Amazing, there are 
so many different styles~! 
Mmm~! I like this one and this one! Not 
feeling that one. For this one, I only 
like the color~!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought. You run on pure 
intuition☆ You're the type who'd rather 
pick at a glance from sketches than hash 
out the details in words, right? 
...*Bling*! I can see it now!

text_block_list.name: Client
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so...! By the way, I'm sorry about 
the other day. 
To be honest, when I told my mom what 
happened, she got really mad at me...

text_block_list.name: Client
text_block_list.text:
She told me, 'Stop constantly changing 
your mind. If you can't explain what you 
want, leave it to the professionals!' 
...So...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Understanding desires that 
can't be put into words is part of our job 
too. 
That was my own shortcoming. In fact, you 
taught me an invaluable lesson!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just as the buzz around "Beauty 
Anshinzawa's Return" began to settle, five 
invitations arrived at the Academy...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Heh, well aren't they classy...! 
I'm flattered... naturally, I'll be 
"running in this race"!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is what it means when 'a dream won't 
let you go.' I knew that with just a 
little time to refresh herself, she'd 
start creating again whether she wanted to 
or not.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
People like her become professionals in 
the first place precisely because they 
can't throw it away. That crazy urge where 
you just can't stop creating—that is the 
true nature of 'talent.'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! That's pretty deep!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That goes for you too, Vodka. You, who 
came right back at the slightest spark. 
You've long been hopelessly entangled in 
your dream.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I can't tell if you're praising me 
or threatening me... 
I don't really get it, but I got it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Seriously...! Do you really even get it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, some time later... 
The "Beauty Dream Cup" was finally held.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The surprise that "this year's Muses would 
be selected via direct offers rather than 
auditions" 
was generating huge buzz...!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hiii, everyone☆ Thanks for coming! 
I was truly, truly indebted to you all 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Bu-ut! This invitation isn't just a "token 
of gratitude." 
It's because I felt true beauty in you all 
during the days we spent together.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The way you stood back up no matter how 
many times you fell, in pursuit of victory 
and your Racewear. 
Seeing that made my chest tighten with, 
"Why would they go so far?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
However... that was proof of your 
sincerity. 
Yes! Both "dreams" and "passion" are 
painful precisely because you're in 
earnest!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, I can feel proud of having agonized 
through my slump. 
Because your brilliance taught me that 
such struggles are also "beauty."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And to you all, my Racewear wishes to 
propose. 
Pleading, "Please, won't you become this 
year's Muses?"...!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Having fallen in love with you, upgraded 
Racewear awaits. 
Will you engage with them? Come, let me 
hear your answers—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Isn't that cool as hell! Heheh... 
don't make me blush. 
I never thought you'd be the one to ask, 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I... don't ever wanna run away like a lame 
coward like I did before. 
But, if I ever get down again... I want 
you to push me forward.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you do, I'll fire myself right back up! 
Let's run together, as many times as it 
takes! So... that's why...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My answer is of course... Y-Y-YES! 
I'll gladly engage with ya!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so pretty...! Does it suit me? Fufu, 
of course it does. 
It's me, after all! I gladly accept your 
proposal.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... there were times I 
thought, "Maybe not this year," 
but I never truly gave up, not once.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because seizing a chance is entirely up to 
oneself. 
Believing that the moment would come, I 
trained with everything I had and waited.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, now that I've become a Muse, I 
won't run half-hearted races. 
I swear that I'll keep aiming for first 
place forever and always!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You chose... Machan, didn't you? 
I'm so happy. My heart is pounding...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I knew it all along. 
That from the hands of the returned 
Beauty-san, a beautiful Racewear like you 
would be born.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for never letting go of her 
hand. 
Thanks to that, Machan and the others were 
able to engage like this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today's race is just the beginning. 
In sickness and in health, let's stay 
together for a long, long time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! As expected of the girls chosen by 
my Racewear. 
What beautiful replies! Now then, what 
about the remaining two...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, then I'll go next... 
Dear Racewear, thank you for proposing to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if someone like me was really 
good enough, 
but becoming a Muse has always been my 
dream, so I'm so very happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not strong yet, so I can only take 
things step by step, 
but as long as you're with me, I'm sure 
I'll never forget my true dream.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So... I will do my absolute best. Let's 
find happiness together. 
I may be inexperienced, but please take 
good care of me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So I'm batting cleanup, huh... Well, 
having to give a formal answer like this 
is kinda embarrassing, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm... not really used to being told 
things like this. 
Well, taking the lead myself just suits my 
personality better, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Seriously... you've got some nerve. 
Proposing to me of all people. 
My answer is "Yes"! Now that that's 
settled, you'd better keep up with me from 
now on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No matter what comes ahead, I'll rock you 
with style! 
This Big Sis Hishi Ama will make you shine 
with everything she's got on the track!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOW☆ All five proposals were a massive 
success! 
I'm so glad the feelings of my Racewear 
reached them...♡

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, riding on this wave of pure 
happiness... 
The "Beauty Dream Cup" is officially 
underway—!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And it has begun—this year's Beauty Dream 
Cup! 
Five gorgeous Muses are fiercely competing 
for victory!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hishi Amazon is making her move...! 
With her white hem fluttering, she's 
closing the gap all at once!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
—GOOOAL! Radiant with an aura of pure 
bliss, the Muses 
have crossed the finish line! Resounding 
applause thunders across the turf!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haa! Haa...! What a great race! 
Every single one of you looks stunning! It 
suits you all so well!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You too, Hishi Ama-san! Fufufu...♪ 
A lot happened along the way, but I'm so 
glad everyone is smiling now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! You bet! For a moment there, I 
wondered how things would turn out. 
Right, Beauty-san?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop it~! We agreed not to bring that 
up anymore~☆ 
I'm totally fine now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I won't lose anymore. I 
can pick myself up as many times as it 
takes. 
Thank you! My strong, beautiful Muses...!
